text: Bwin is one of Entain plc's sports betting brands: Entain's German-licence announcement says the Group offers gaming 'under its bwin, Ladbrokes and Sportingbet brands', and the same release describes Entain plc as an FTSE100 company (LSE: ENT) whose Sports Brands include bwin and Coral.
short: Bwin is an Entain plc brand; Entain is an FTSE100 listed company with no state owner.

source.name: Entain: Entain granted gaming and poker licences in Germany (company news release)
source.quote: enabling it to offer gaming under its bwin, Ladbrokes and Sportingbet brands, and poker under bwin and Ladbrokes.
source.note: Same page, About section: 'Entain plc (LSE: ENT) is an FTSE100 company ... Sports Brands include bwin, Coral, Crystalbet, Eurobet, Ladbrokes, Neds, Sportingbet and Sports Interaction'.

additionalSources.name: FC Arouca: 'Mudança Histórica em Arouca: Bwin é o novo main sponsor do FC Arouca' (club announcement of the bwin front-of-shirt deal)
additionalSources.quote: O FC Arouca inicia uma nova etapa da sua história com a entrada da bwin como Main Sponsor do clube. O acordo, válido por quatro épocas, com opção por uma quinta temporada
additionalSources.note: Establishes the sponsor link: bwin is FC Arouca's main sponsor from 2026-27, replacing Construções Carlos Pinho after more than a decade.
